name: Divine Astra
body:
You imbue your deity’s aura into your flying blades, conjuring magnificent divine armaments.

Prerequisite(s): summon flying blade class feature, worship a deity, either domain class feature, Weapon Focus (deity’s favored weapon), or blessing class feature.

Benefit(s): When you create a flying blade that matches your deity’s favored weapon, it counts as a weapon aligned to match the alignment of your deity (so lawful good deity would create a lawful- and goodaligned flying blade). Additionally, you may treat it as a holy symbol of your deity.
